title: Deen e islam ko karbal mein bachatay hai hussain
body:
Deen e islam ko karbal mein bachatay hai hussain, istarha wada e tiflee ko nibhatay hai hussain.
1. apni aulad fida kar ke baqa e deen par, kufr ka naam zamane se mitatay hai hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. nazr kartey huway qaleq ko shahadath ke gulab, ek beyaban ko qulistan banatay hai hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. aao aiyub zara sabr ke jauhar dekho, sabr ki shaan hai kya aaj batatay hai hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
4.dekh kar qaimay ke dar se ye kaha fizza na, lash nausha ki maidan se laatay hai hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. hai qayamath ka sama koi madadgar nahi, hai laasha ali akbar ka uthatay hai hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
6.haal besheer ka kistarha batau maa ko, ran se qaiyme ko yahi sochtay jatay hai hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. maa khadi dekh rahi hai yeh dareh qayme se, qabr maidaan mein asghar ki banatay hai hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
8.jo uthatay hai alamdare jari kari parcham, usko har ranj o musibath se bachatay hai hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
9.tazkera hota hai abbas e jari ka jisdam, saath shahzadi e kaunain ke aate hai hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
10.rishta quraan ka itrat se nahi hoga juda, noke naiza se bhi quran sunatay hai hussain.
<<DIVIDER>>
11.jis ke dil mein bhi ziyarat ki tadap hai sahil, bilyaqeen karbobala usko bulatay hai hussain
